name: Kangoku S ~10 Days~
source:
The main character is arrested after trying to sneak up on a girl and take dirty pictures of her.
He is detained for 10 days, but the prison he was taken to turned out to be under the control of two females that appear to be female officers!!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE044114.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
主角因企圖偷偷接近一名女孩、拍下她的色情照而遭到逮捕。
他被拘留十天，然而關押他的監獄似乎竟由兩名女獄警掌控！！

[摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE044114.html]DLsite English[/url]]
